pose: He holds his sword Second Harvest loosely in one hand, point-down and angled slightly away from his body so the blade does NOT cross or obscure his torso or legs — the full costume must stay readable. His other arm relaxed at his side.
signature_item_second_harvest: Second Harvest, his signature sword — the blade shape is distinctive and image-specific and must be rendered in full: a single-edged blade that does NOT simply taper to a point. Simple straight cross-guard, wire-wrapped grip, round pommel. A working blade with honest wear and edge nicks.
